automatic_stop_policy: Any admission failure or unknown model/tool completion stops this stage. Every original task remains in the descriptive denominator, including not_started tasks. Known per-task budget exhaustion may be managed only by a separately frozen saved-evidence step, never by this automatic run permission.
resource_scope: One fixed registry and shared nominal research budget across four equal task caps. Reserves are admission exposure, not a hard per-call output or supplier invoice limit. Engineering and review usage is separate and not claimed to be zero. Runtime counts from campaign creation and controls next admission; the in-flight call has its own timeout.
exposure_scope: Controller and evaluators have inspected generator design and private specifications. Researchers receive only the original ordinary public packet, published workbench contract and own verified transcript in a fresh tools-disabled invocation. These are exposed synthetic development investigations.
cost_scope: Workbench horizon and conditioning results are gross endpoint diagnostics with costs_applied=false. Packet fee assumptions are declared for a future equal-budget reference and have not been simulated. No result from this run qualifies a net-performance positive control.
claim_scope: Descriptive ordinary-input discovery, evidence correctness, uncertainty handling, abstention and resource-control observations only. No architecture superiority, stable strategy success rate or future profitability conclusion.
next_gate: Composite v15 validation must pass. Prepare exactly once, inspect its concrete plan and all four zero-action workbenches, and obtain a separately hash-bound independent admission receipt before the run command. This scope document alone does not authorize a dispatch.
